predecessors.name: Later Zhao
predecessors.text: 'the Shandong peninsula', Qing province, 'modern central and eastern Shandong' (Duan Qi page)

successors.name: Former Yan
successors.text: 'the Shandong peninsula', Qing province, 'modern central and eastern Shandong' (Duan Qi page)

rulers.name: Duan Kan (King of Qi 350-351, then Duke of Qi)

ledger.x: 350: Duan Kan founds the Qi in Shandong.
Early 356: Murong Ke crosses the Yellow River.

wars.name: Former Yan conquest of Duan Qi
wars.outcome: Murong Ke crossed the Yellow River in early 356, besieged Guanggu, and Duan Kan surrendered on 22 December 356; Shandong passed to Former Yan.

certainty.note: A warlord state in a collapsed province: no boundary on the page; only the capital and the 'central and eastern Shandong' line.
